subject: Go/no-go outcome: conditional go, gated on a guarded live A/B
body:
Team,

Outcome of Monday's go/no-go with Mateo: conditional go.

The condition: before H2 funding is confirmed, we run a guarded live A/B on 1% of pilot traffic to validate Carmen's off-policy estimates - value-penalty KL config, hard guardrails, automatic rollback on any regression in the safety metrics. Kofi's privacy sign-off came through last week so nothing blocks the design work.

Decisions:
1. Carmen + Nikhil write the A/B design doc by 5/18 (window close). The A/B itself runs under the H2 program's banner.
2. Wanjiru packages the training stack for handoff - whoever staffs H2 inherits clean infra.
3. The +4% offline estimate goes in the memo with its confidence interval, not as a headline number. We are not overselling this one.

Realistic, evidence-shaped bet. Thanks everyone.

Ulla
